sentences.en: This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year, listening back and hearing what's happened in the time since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 本周，《每日新闻》（The Daily）将回顾今年我们最喜欢的一些单集，再次聆听并了解自它们首次播出以来发生的事情。

sentences.en: Today, we return to a mother and daughter who, along with hundreds of thousands of others, made a harrowing journey through the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们回访了一对母女，她们和成千上万的人一样，经历了穿越达连隘口（Darien Gap）的惊险旅程。

sentences.en: And we find out where they ended up.
sentences.zh: 我们去看看她们最终到了哪里。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月28日，星期四。

sentences.en: Julie, tell us what we should know about this place, the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，跟我们讲讲我们该如何看待这个地方——达连隘口。

sentences.en: So the Darien Gap is this narrow sliver of land between Colombia and Panama.
sentences.zh: 达连隘口是哥伦比亚和巴拿马之间一处狭长的土地。

sentences.en: It connects South and Central Americas.
sentences.zh: 它连接了南美洲和中美洲。

sentences.en: And this slip of land is a jungle, and it's an extremely inhospitable jungle.
sentences.zh: 这片狭长的土地是一片丛林，而且是一片极其不宜居的丛林。

sentences.en: And this is because the territory is sheer mountains, intense, intense mud.
sentences.zh: 这是因为这里地形陡峭，到处都是极度黏稠的泥泞。

sentences.en: To be able to traverse it on foot is very dangerous because there are deadly animals, bugs, snakes, fast running rivers.
sentences.zh: 徒步穿过这里非常危险，因为有致命的动物、昆虫、蛇和湍急的河流。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it's sort of a changing territory, too, because it's incredibly wet.
sentences.zh: 而且这里的地形也在不断变化，因为实在太潮湿了。

sentences.en: This place has no road.
sentences.zh: 这个地方没有公路。

sentences.en: So for years, what you saw was that a small number of migrants who sort of heard word of mouth about the possibility of crossing, that they could do it, were braving this trek.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多年里，你会发现只有少数几个通过口耳相传听说可以穿行、并且觉得自己能做到的难民，在冒险进行这场徒步。

sentences.en: And so you saw between 2010 and 2020, an average of under 11,000 people crossing a year.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以看到，在2010年到2020年间，平均每年有不到11,000人穿行。

sentences.en: What you've seen in the last two years is an enormous historic rise in people crossing this very dangerous, in many cases, deadly jungle.
sentences.zh: 而你在过去两年里看到的，是穿越这片极其危险、在许多情况下甚至会致命的丛林的人数出现了历史性的巨大飙升。

sentences.en: How many more people?
sentences.zh: 多了多少人？

sentences.en: What we saw in 2022 was almost 250,000 people cross the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 我们在2022年看到的是，将近25万人在穿行达连隘口。

sentences.en: And what explains why so many people are trying to take this treacherous journey right now?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么原因解释了为什么现在有这么多人试图进行这趟充满风险的旅程？

sentences.en: So first of all, the pandemic really hit economies in South America hard.
sentences.zh: 首先，大流行对南美洲的经济造成了沉重打击。

sentences.en: And because the crisis was region-wide, this left one way out.
sentences.zh: 由于这场危机波及整个地区，这只留给人们一条出路。

sentences.en: And that way out was north through the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 而那条出路就是向北穿过达连隘口。

sentences.en: And so we see traffickers advertising on social media, encouraging people to come through the gap, talking about this trek as if it's a vacation.
sentences.zh: 于是我们看到人口贩子在社交媒体上做广告，鼓励人们穿过隘口，把这趟徒步说得就像是一场度假一样。

sentences.en: So I needed to make sense of this contradiction that I was seeing between this incredibly harsh terrain,
sentences.zh: 所以我需要理清我所看到的这种矛盾现象：

sentences.en: this idea that this place is an impassable jungle and these numbers that we were seeing.
sentences.zh: 一方面是极其严苛的地形、这地方是不可逾越的丛林的观念，另一方面则是我们看到的这些数字。

sentences.en: And so my colleague, Fede, Federico Rios, photographer, and I decided that the only way really to do this was to do the trek ourselves.
sentences.zh: 因此，我的同事、摄影师费代——费德里科·里奥斯（Federico Rios）和我决定，真正做到这一点的唯一方法就是我们自己去走一趟这片丛林。

sentences.en: And so we set out to cross the Darien Gap.
sentences.zh: 于是我们出发去穿过达连隘口。

sentences.en: So tell us, Julie, about this journey.
sentences.zh: 那么朱莉，给我们讲讲这段旅程吧。

sentences.en: So I started the journey in Necocli, the beach town in Colombia that serves as the jumping-off point for the trip through the Darien.
sentences.zh: 我从内科克利（Necocli）开始了这段旅程，这是哥伦比亚的一个海滩小镇，也是穿过达连地区的起点。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Hola.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hola.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Buenas.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: So from Necocli, the migrants have to cross this large body of water, this gulf, to get to the point where the jungle begins.
sentences.zh: 所以从内科克利出发，难民们必须穿过这片广阔的水域、这个海湾，才能到达丛林开始的地方。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so I have to say, we were totally struck by the organization and the operation of the entire thing.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，整个事情的组织和运作完全震撼了我们。

sentences.en: Daniel Jose Muñoz.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·何塞·穆尼奥斯（Daniel Jose Muñoz）。

sentences.en: Daniel Jose Muñoz.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·何塞·穆尼奥斯。

sentences.en: These formerly tourist boat, now migrant boat companies, are calling the migrants one by one to, you know, get on their assigned boat after they've bought their ticket.
sentences.zh: 这些以前是旅游船、现在是难民船的公司，在难民买好票后，正一个接一个地叫他们去登上分配给他们的船。

sentences.en: So we get on this boat with a large group of migrants on their way to start this journey.
sentences.zh: 于是我们和一大群在踏上这段旅程途中的难民一起登上了这艘船。

sentences.en: And we reach Kapurgana, the last town before people enter the jungle.
sentences.zh: 我们到达了卡普尔加纳（Kapurgana），这是人们进入丛林前的最后一个小镇。

sentences.en: So we are leaving now to begin this hike.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正要出发开始这次徒步。

sentences.en: We're a group of maybe 100 people.
sentences.zh: 我们大约有100人。

sentences.en: There's lots of children.
sentences.zh: 有很多小孩子。

sentences.en: Everybody is completely laden down with bags and mats to sleep on and things like that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都大包小包、背着用来睡觉的垫子之类的东西，负重累累。

sentences.en: So we set off for what would be, for most of these migrants, a journey of somewhere between six and ten days in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 于是我们出发了，对大多数这些难民来说，这将是一段在丛林中持续六到十天的旅程。

sentences.en: And pretty soon the terrain gets very steep.
sentences.zh: 很快地形就变得非常陡峭。

sentences.en: And it's very hot.
sentences.zh: 而且天气非常热。

sentences.en: It's very hot.
sentences.zh: 非常热。

sentences.en: People are struggling.
sentences.zh: 人们在挣扎。

sentences.en: They're breathing hard.
sentences.zh: 他们大口喘着粗气。

sentences.en: Some people start to cry.
sentences.zh: 有些人开始哭泣。

sentences.en: And then it starts to get really difficult.
sentences.zh: 然后情况开始变得真的非常艰难。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And somehow people are getting through this with children in their arms or on their backs.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，人们怀里抱着或背上背着孩子在通过这里。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Lots of children.
sentences.zh: 有很多孩子。

sentences.en: Lots and lots of children.
sentences.zh: 非常非常多的孩子。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So by the time that we are two days in, we really start to see people fall apart.
sentences.zh: 所以到了我们进山的第二天，我们真的开始看到人们精神崩溃。

sentences.en: They start to get sick.
sentences.zh: 他们开始生病。

sentences.en: They start to get injured.
sentences.zh: 他们开始受伤。

sentences.en: There's a pregnant woman who we watch fall down an extremely steep hill.
sentences.zh: 我们眼睁睁看着一个孕妇从极其陡峭的山坡上摔了下去。

sentences.en: And it becomes clear that some people aren't going to make this journey.
sentences.zh: 并且很明显，有些人无法完成这段旅程。

sentences.en: They're not going to survive.
sentences.zh: 他们无法存活下来。

sentences.en: We did come across a dead body on the trail.
sentences.zh: 我们在小路上确实遇到了一具尸体。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You often heard adults singing with kids just to keep their spirits up.
sentences.zh: 你经常听到成年人跟孩子们一起唱歌，只是为了振奋他们的精神。

sentences.en: So by the fourth day, we have crossed into Panama.
sentences.zh: 到了第四天，我们已经进入了巴拿马。

sentences.en: We are about halfway through the journey, and we're about to do the most difficult part of the trek, what is called the Hill of Death.
sentences.zh: 我们完成了大约一半的旅程，正准备进行整段徒步中最困难的部分，也就是所谓的“死亡之山”。

sentences.en: And it's on this hill that I meet Sarah.
sentences.zh: 正是在这座山上，我遇到了萨拉（Sarah）。

sentences.en: How many years have you?
sentences.zh: 你几岁了？

sentences.en: Six.
sentences.zh: 六岁。

sentences.en: And Sarah is this tiny six-year-old girl from Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 萨拉是来自委内瑞拉的一个六岁小女孩。

sentences.en: She's wearing this tiny pink t-shirt with sparkles on it.
sentences.zh: 她穿着一件带有亮片的粉红色小T恤。

sentences.en: And she is climbing the Hill of Death with a man named Ángel.
sentences.zh: 她正和一个叫安赫尔（Ángel）的男人一起攀登死亡之山。

sentences.en: He's not her father, and I see Ángel help Sarah to make it up and then down the Hill of Death.
sentences.zh: 他不是她的父亲，我看到安赫尔帮助萨拉爬上又爬下了死亡之山。

sentences.en: We're going to camp between a couple of trees by the river.
sentences.zh: 我们打算在河边几棵树之间露营。

sentences.en: Fede is making a clearing, basically, with a machete.
sentences.zh: 费代基本上是用一把大砍刀在清理出一块空地。

sentences.en: And, you know, as we're setting up camp for the night, I got to know Sarah a little bit more.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，在我们安营扎寨过夜的时候，我对萨拉有了更多的了解。

sentences.en: Earlier in the journey, Sarah's mother had then become injured.
sentences.zh: 在旅程的早些时候，萨拉的母亲受伤了。

sentences.en: And that morning had asked Ángel if he could help her by carrying Sarah at points, by guiding her while she trudged along in her injured state.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，她请求安赫尔能否帮帮忙，在某些路段背一下萨拉，在她拖着受伤的身体艰难前行时指引她。

sentences.en: And by the time I met them, no one knew where her mother was.
sentences.zh: 等我遇到他们时，没有人知道她的母亲在哪里。

sentences.en: It wasn't clear to us if she was even alive.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不清楚她是否还活着。

sentences.en: It really seemed to exemplify what a cruel journey this was.
sentences.zh: 这真的很典型地展现了这是一段多么残酷的旅程。

sentences.en: That a mother would be pushed, some would say forced, to hand her child, the fate of her child, to someone she had really just met.
sentences.zh: 一位母亲竟然会被逼得——有些人会说是被迫——把自己的孩子、把孩子的命运交到一个刚刚认识的人手里。

sentences.en: All in the hopes of making it through the Daring Gap and making it to the United States.
sentences.zh: 这一切都只是为了能穿过达连隘口并到达美国。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wynna Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky）。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉（promesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到声音的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So what happens the next morning?
sentences.zh: 那么第二天早上发生了什么？

sentences.en: So Sarah's group wakes up very early and they tell us that they are going to head out.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的一行人在很早的时候醒来，他们告诉我们他们要出发了。

sentences.en: I asked Sarah for a description of her mother in case I saw her later that day and could interview her, could tell her that Sarah was okay.
sentences.zh: 我向萨拉索取了她母亲的体貌特征描述，以防我那天晚些时候见到她并能采访她，告诉她萨拉很好。

sentences.en: And I'm told that Sarah's mother looks exactly like her.
sentences.zh: 我被告知萨拉的母亲长得跟她一模一样。

sentences.en: Same hair, same skin.
sentences.zh: 同样的头发，同样的皮肤。

sentences.en: Sarah's group leaves.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的一行人离开了。

sentences.en: And Fede and I decide we're going to wait and hope that we find the mother.
sentences.zh: 费代和我决定留下来，希望能找到这位母亲。

sentences.en: And sure enough, a few hours later, a woman matching the description we were given comes down the hill.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，几个小时后，一个符合我们所听到的描述的女人从山上走了下来。

sentences.en: And I ask her, are you Sarah's mother?
sentences.zh: 我问她，你是萨拉的母亲吗？

sentences.en: And she exclaims and she wants to know immediately if her daughter is okay.
sentences.zh: 她惊呼出来，并迫不及待地想知道她的女儿是否安好。

sentences.en: By this point, it's been more than a day since she'd seen her only child.
sentences.zh: 此时距离她见到自己唯一的孩子已经过去了一天多。

sentences.en: They'd been on this journey for about six days so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，她们已经在这段旅程中走了大约六天。

sentences.en: Her name is Alexandra.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫亚历山德拉（Alexandra）。

sentences.en: Sarah's mom tells me that she has terrible blisters on her feet.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的妈妈告诉我，她的脚上满是可怕的水泡。

sentences.en: So we sat down on a log by a river and I asked her what landed her here.
sentences.zh: 于是我们坐在河边的一段木头上，我问她是什么落到了这般田地。

sentences.en: How did she get here?
sentences.zh: 她是怎么来到这里的？

sentences.en: Why is she here?
sentences.zh: 她为什么会在这里？

sentences.en: She told me she was a lawyer in Venezuela, but when the country's oil industry collapsed, her business collapsed.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我她曾在委内瑞拉做律师，但当该国的石油产业崩溃时，她的业务也破产了。

sentences.en: So earlier that year, she had left Venezuela, crossed on foot the Atacama Desert to make it into Chile, where she thought that she could build a new life.
sentences.zh: 所以在今年早些时候，她离开了委内瑞拉，徒步穿越阿塔卡马沙漠（Atacama Desert）进入智利，她以为在那里可以建立新的生活。

sentences.en: But she couldn't practice law there because she didn't have the right paperwork.
sentences.zh: 但由于没有正确的文件，她无法在那里从事法律工作。

sentences.en: And Alexandra tells me that she's under the impression that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉告诉我，她以为美国会让她入境并让她留在国内。

sentences.en: will let her in and let her stay in the country.
sentences.zh: 这就是她想抚养女儿的地方。

sentences.en: And this is where she wants to raise her daughter.
sentences.zh: 这就是她当初踏上这段徒步的原因。

sentences.en: That's what brought her on this trek in the first place.
sentences.zh: 她对自已与女儿失散的事实感到极其惊恐不安。

sentences.en: She's just horrified by the fact that she's become separated from her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她对女儿正在经历的一切感到惊恐不安。

sentences.en: She's horrified by what her daughter is going through.
sentences.zh: 我们道了别，我继续前行，希望能赶上萨拉，告诉她她的母亲还活着并且很好。

sentences.en: So we say goodbye, and I continued on, hoping that I might catch back up with Sarah and tell her that her mother was alive and okay.
sentences.zh: 此时已经是第七天了。

sentences.en: By this point, it's day seven.
sentences.zh: 我们精疲力竭，但费代和我前进的速度仍然比亚历山德拉快得多，我们觉得我们或许能在下一个营地赶上萨拉。

sentences.en: We are exhausted, but Fede and I are still moving much faster than Alexandra, and we think we might be able to catch up with Sarah at the next camp.
sentences.zh: 我们终于、终于到达了一个叫埃尔阿布埃洛（El Abuelo）的地方。

sentences.en: So we're finally, finally arriving at a place called El Abuelo.
sentences.zh: 下一个营地是一个叫埃尔阿布埃洛的地方，当我们安顿下来时，我开始寻找萨拉的身影。

sentences.en: The next camp is a place called El Abuelo, and as we settle in, I start scanning for Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我发现了萨拉和安赫尔，我立刻告诉萨拉我见到她的妈妈了，她只落后了一两天。

sentences.en: And I spot Sarah and Ángel, and I immediately tell Sarah that I've met her mom, that she's just a day or two behind.
sentences.zh: 安赫尔告诉我，自我上次见到他们以来，萨拉一直在哭泣。

sentences.en: And Ángel tells me that since I last saw them, Sarah has been crying a lot.
sentences.zh: 她一直在不停地打听她妈妈的消息，当我跟她说话时，她要求在这个营地等待，在埃尔阿布埃洛等着她的妈妈来和他们会合。

sentences.en: She's been asking about her mom nonstop, and as I'm talking to her, she's asking to wait at this camp, to wait at El Abuelo for her mom to meet them there.
sentences.zh: 但安赫尔已经决定，他们需要做的是到达旅程的终点，那里有一个政府营地，

sentences.en: But Ángel has decided that what they need to do is get to the end of the trek, where there's
sentences.zh: 在这一路上失散的孩子们可以呆在那里，直到他们与父母重新团聚。

sentences.en: a government camp where children who have been separated along this journey can stay until they are reunited with their parents.
So I tell them that I'm staying behind to do reporting, and that Alexandra is probably a day behind.
sentences.zh: 所以我告诉他们我留下来做报道，亚历山德拉大概落后一天。

sentences.en: I know I can wait and try and connect with her at this camp.
sentences.zh: 我知道我可以等一下，并尝试在这个营地与她汇合。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So we're waiting at El Abuelo.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在埃尔阿布埃洛等待。

sentences.en: I see this boat arrive.
sentences.zh: 我看到这艘船到了。

sentences.en: Alexandra has just arrived on a boat.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉刚刚乘船抵达。

sentences.en: Her feet are so destroyed that she can't walk.
sentences.zh: 她的双脚伤得那么重，根本无法走路。

sentences.en: She's like crying, and she's shaking.
sentences.zh: 她一边哭一边发抖。

sentences.en: She hasn't eaten or had anything to drink in two days.
sentences.zh: 她已经两天没吃东西也没喝水了。

sentences.en: I tell her that I saw Sarah, that Sarah is just up ahead.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她我看到萨拉了，萨拉就在前面不远。

sentences.en: And all she wants to do is get moving immediately.
sentences.zh: 而她唯一想做的就是立刻出发。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to eat.
sentences.zh: 她不想吃东西。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to sleep.
sentences.zh: 她不想睡觉。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to reSt.
sentences.zh: 她不想休息。

sentences.en: She just wants to find her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她只想找到她的女儿。

sentences.en: And so we get in this boat to head toward the government UN camp together.
sentences.zh: 于是我们上了这艘船，一起前往政府的联合国营地。

sentences.en: So this is Alexandra arriving at Canaan, which is this community in Panama where her daughter should be.
sentences.zh: 这是亚历山德拉到达迦南时的情景，这是巴拿马的一个社区，她的女儿应该就在那里。

sentences.en: So we get off the boat, as before, she needs to be carried.
sentences.zh: 我们下了船，和之前一样，她需要被人抱着。

sentences.en: She's scanning for her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她四处张望寻找女儿。

sentences.en: And finally, she is taken by Panamanian officials to one of the shacks.
sentences.zh: 最后，她被巴拿马官员带到了其中一个棚屋里。

sentences.en: And there inside the shack is Sarah, is her daughter.
sentences.zh: 屋里正是萨拉，她的女儿。

sentences.en: And we are watching this reunion happen.
sentences.zh: 我们正在看着这场重聚发生。

sentences.en: And Alexandra just, you know, she grabs her daughter.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉就这样，你知道的，她抓住了她的女儿。

sentences.en: She holds her.
sentences.zh: 她抱住了她。

sentences.en: And she starts asking for forgiveness right away.
sentences.zh: 她立刻开始请求原谅。

sentences.en: Please forgive me.
sentences.zh: 请原谅我。

sentences.en: Please forgive me.
sentences.zh: 请原谅我。

sentences.en: You know, I didn't abandon you, is what she says.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我没有抛弃你，她是这么说的。

sentences.en: They had been separated now for three days.
sentences.zh: 她们当时已经分开三天了。

sentences.en: Sarah seemed kind of to be in shock.
sentences.zh: 萨拉看起来似乎有点处于震惊之中。

sentences.en: It was a very bittersweet reunion because they hadn't even made it near the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是一次非常苦乐参半的重聚，因为她们甚至还没能接近美国。

sentences.en: They still had so much more to do.
sentences.zh: 她们还有很长的路要走。

sentences.en: After the break, Julie Turkowicz gives us an update on what Alexandra and Sarah are now doing.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，朱莉·图尔科维奇为我们带来关于亚历山德拉和萨拉现状的最新报道。

sentences.en: This is Julie Turkowicz, Andes Bureau Chief.
sentences.zh: 这是安第斯分社长朱莉·图尔科维奇。

sentences.en: Since this episode aired, my colleague Federico Rios and I have kept in touch with Alexandra.
sentences.zh: 自从这期节目播出以来，我和我的同事费德里科·里奥斯一直与亚历山德拉保持着联系。

sentences.en: After Alexandra and Sarah crossed Daring Gap, they continued their journey north to try and get to the United States.
sentences.zh: 在亚历山德拉和萨拉穿过达连隘口后，她们继续向北旅程，试图到达美国。

sentences.en: And as they were traveling through Central America, they heard that the Biden administration had made a really important policy change.
sentences.zh: 当她们穿过中美洲时，她们听说拜登政府做出了一项非常重要的政策调整。

sentences.en: The new policy would no longer allow Venezuelans to enter at the Mexico-U.S.
sentences.zh: 新政策将不再允许委内瑞拉人从美墨

sentences.en: border.
sentences.zh: 边境入境。

sentences.en: Instead, the government was going to open up slots for Venezuelans in a program called
sentences.zh: 相反，政府将在一个名为

sentences.en: Humanitarian Parole.
sentences.zh: 人道主义假释的计划中为委内瑞拉人开放名额。

sentences.en: And it was going to give them a safe, legal way to get into the United States.
sentences.zh: 这将为他们提供一条安全、合法的途径进入美国。

sentences.en: So Alexandra decides that she has just suffered too much.
sentences.zh: 因此，亚历山德拉认为她已经遭受了太多苦难。

sentences.en: She does not want to risk her daughter's life anymore on any other part of the journey.
sentences.zh: 她不想在旅程的任何其他部分再冒着女儿的生命危险。

sentences.en: And she is going to apply for this legal option.
sentences.zh: 她打算申请这个合法的选择。

sentences.en: She just has one problem.
sentences.zh: 她只有一个问题。

sentences.en: And that's that for the humanitarian parole program, you need to have a person in the United
sentences.zh: 那就是对于人道主义假释计划，你需要在美国有一个人

sentences.en: States who says, hey, I commit to supporting this person, even financially, when they get to the United States.
sentences.zh: 说，嘿，我承诺支持这个人，甚至包括经济上的支持，当他们到达美国时。

sentences.en: And then the article comes out.
sentences.zh: 然后文章发表了。

sentences.en: And we had a huge, huge response from New York Times readers, several of whom reached out and said, we want to be the sponsors.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了《纽约时报》读者的大量热烈反响，其中几个人联系我们说，我们想成为担保人。

sentences.en: And they submitted applications for this humanitarian parole program.
sentences.zh: 他们提交了这个官夫人道主义假释计划的申请。

sentences.en: So now we are more than a year later.
sentences.zh: 所以现在一年多过去了。

sentences.en: All Alexandra has heard from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉从美国

sentences.en: government is that it has been received.
sentences.zh: 政府那里听到的唯一消息就是申请已被收到。

sentences.en: And she wakes up every morning, checks the status of her application and refreshes and refreshes,
sentences.zh: 她每天早晨醒来，检查申请的状态并不断刷新，

sentences.en: hoping that one day it will say that her application has been accepted and that she will be able to come to the United States.
sentences.zh: 希望有一天它会显示她的申请已被接受，她将能够来到美国。

sentences.en: Meantime, they are in a pretty unstable situation.
sentences.zh: 同时，她们处在一个相当不稳定的境地。

sentences.en: They've asked us not to reveal their specific location.
sentences.zh: 她们要求我们不要透露她们的具体位置。

sentences.en: They are in a situation of poverty.
sentences.zh: 她们处于贫困之中。

sentences.en: And Alexandra really tries to maintain hope.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德拉一直在努力保持希望。

sentences.en: In the time since the episode aired, I have also been speaking with Angel.
sentences.zh: 在节目播出后的这段时间里，我也一直在和安赫尔交谈。

sentences.en: Angel is the man who helped Sarah when she lost her mother in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 安赫尔就是那个在萨拉在丛林中与母亲失散时帮助过她的人。

sentences.en: He took a very different path and he decided to continue on to the United States.
sentences.zh: 他走了完全不同的路，决定继续前往美国。

sentences.en: He eventually made it to Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 他最终到达了宾夕法尼亚州。

sentences.en: He got a work permit and a social security number.
sentences.zh: 他获得了工作许可和社会安全号。

sentences.en: And now he's making $140 a day as a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 现在他作为机械师每天赚140美元。

sentences.en: And, you know, life is difficult.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，生活很艰难。

sentences.en: His family is now broken apart.
sentences.zh: 他的家庭现在破裂了。

sentences.en: But he feels that in the U.S., making this amount of money, he can deliver on what he set out to do.
sentences.zh: 但他觉得在美国赚到这笔钱，他就能兑现他当初的目标。

sentences.en: And this is what made him cross the Derry Inn.
sentences.zh: 这也是他穿越达连隘口的原因。

sentences.en: He can help his child back home and he can fulfill what he sees as his duties as a father.
sentences.zh: 他可以帮助家里的孩子，并且能够履行他作为父亲的职责。

sentences.en: So, last year, when we were with Alexandra and Sarah, 248,000 people crossed the Derry Inn Gap.
sentences.zh: 所以，去年，当我们和亚历山德拉与萨拉在一起时，有24.8万人穿越了达连隘口。

sentences.en: That was a record annual high.
sentences.zh: 那是创纪录的年度最高水平。

sentences.en: This year, we are about to hit 500,000 people crossing this jungle.
sentences.zh: 今年，我们将迎来50万人穿过这片丛林。

sentences.en: The word is out that the Derry Inn Gap is this treacherous pathway to the United States.
sentences.zh: 消息传开，达连隘口是通往美国的这条危机四伏的路径。

sentences.en: And you see large numbers of Ecuadorians, of people from China, people from Afghanistan, taking this route.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到大量厄瓜多尔人、中国人和阿富汗人选择这条路线。

sentences.en: And they are fleeing economic instability, political instability, conflict, war.
sentences.zh: 他们正在逃离经济不稳定、政治不稳定、冲突和战争。

sentences.en: It's not that they don't know that the Derry Inn Gap is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 并不是他们不知道达连隘口很危险。

sentences.en: It's that many of them are making the calculation that the potential reward is worth the risk.
sentences.zh: 而是他们中的许多人经过权衡，认为潜在的回报值得冒这个险。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由悉尼·哈珀和卡洛斯·普里耶托制作，尼娜·费尔德曼和克莱尔·滕尼斯盖特提供帮助。

sentences.zh: 节目由M.J.

sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩和帕特里夏·威兰斯剪辑，丽莎·乔提供帮助。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢艾琳·沙利文。

sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格一起讲述那些试图保持影响力却最终失控的人的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 都市。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: We moving forward, folks gotta go further.
sentences.zh: 我们正在前进，大家必须走得更远。

sentences.en: FirSt.
sentences.zh: 首先。

sentences.en: As some.
sentences.zh: 作为一些。

sentences.en: And let's look ahead.
sentences.zh: 让我们展望未来。

sentences.en: Now let's sit.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们坐下。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
